goal: Build real, end-to-end AO token transfer capability -- construct, sign, and post an AO token-transfer message to a token process -- so estimateTransfer/submitTransfer stop rejecting every request with token !== null, and resolve the wire-contract question debt #7 on GLEAM-WALLET-WALLET-CORE flagged for a Correction Protocol entry.
outcome: packages/core/src/ao gains a transfer module (mirroring arweave/transfer.ts's shape: pure functions accepting an already-decrypted JWK, no chrome.*/window/document dependency) that builds, signs, and posts a real AO Transfer message to a token's process, using whichever AO messaging client/library this task adds as a new core dependency (recorded via its own chore(workspace) commit, per this project's established shared-dependency pattern for a genuinely new stack dependency). handlers/transfer.ts's estimateTransfer/submitTransfer branch on req.token: null routes to the existing AR path unchanged; req.token !== null routes to the new AO path, reusing the same key-session-cache signing-key resolution, the same optimistic-activity-entry-on-submit behavior, and the same firstSeenRecipient computation as the AR path. Every token the popup can list, including AR, is genuinely sendable through this path -- no disabled/'coming soon' state anywhere in it.

requirements.statement: Signing reuses the existing key-session.ts in-memory unlocked-session cache -- no new password field is added anywhere, and no key material is re-derived from a password on this path. This is the Correction Protocol resolution for debt #7 (GLEAM-WALLET-WALLET-CORE): TransferDraft.walletId, already added to the locked ProtocolMap/model by provider-bridge's own prior Correction Protocol entry (per core-design.md), is ratified as the authoritative wire shape -- confirmed as already correct, not reopened or re-widened. Record this ratification as its own dated entry in .hedgehog/core-design.md's Correction Protocol log, referencing debt #7 by id and stating plainly that no code change was needed for the wire contract itself, only this AO-path build.

AR balances/amounts stay Winston atomic-integer strings (GLEAM-WALLET-RULE-5, unchanged); AO token amounts stay atomic-integer strings in the token's own smallest unit, matching TokenBalance.quantity/denomination's existing shape -- never a floating-point number at any layer, on either path.

The AO messaging client/library choice (no such dependency exists in the tree yet -- only @dha-team/arbundles for ANS-104 upload signing and arweave-js are present) is this task's own build-time decision, weighed against extension bundle-size and MV3-CSP-safety constraints the way arbundles/arweave-js were originally chosen. Declare the choice and its rationale via 'hedgehog decision add' on this intent's own task so the ao-send-ui intent (the consuming UI work) and any later layer follow the same choice rather than reinventing it.

core package logic stays free of chrome.*/window/document dependency (GLEAM-WALLET-RULE-1, unchanged) -- the new AO transfer module lives in packages/core/src/ao and is enforced by the same existing ESLint no-restricted-imports rule.
estimateTransfer and submitTransfer both succeed (no 'not implemented' throw) for a TransferDraft with a non-null token processId, given an unlocked wallet with a cached signing key.

submitTransfer for an AO token writes an optimistic ActivityEntry immediately on submit, same as the AR path, with the correct token identity captured (not conflated with an AR entry or with a different token's entry).
estimateTransfer for an AO token still computes firstSeenRecipient against the same merged local+gateway activity history the AR path already uses -- no separate, AO-only recipient-history source.

pnpm vitest run arweave ao pricing activity send receive passes; pnpm tsc -p packages/core --noEmit passes; pnpm wxt build succeeds with the new AO-messaging dependency bundled and declared in packages/core/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.

.hedgehog/core-design.md carries a new, dated Correction Protocol log entry that names debt #7, states the ratification decision (TransferDraft.walletId is the authoritative shape; no password field), and does not modify any earlier entry.
